items.summary: Recommendation: approve only updates to the three existing control workstreams and defer acquiring new domains. Evidence: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failure repairs remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven in the 30-day scorecard. Revenue, margin, ROI, domain pricing, renewal cost, and audience fit for the proposed domains are unknown; no spend limit is set. Smallest next step: drain and measure current work, then run a bounded acquisition analysis. Owner decision: confirm deferral of new-domain acquisition for now.

Handoff: preserve the existing execution, failure-containment, and measurement workstreams. Do not create duplicate proposals, production requests, dependencies, telemetry, spend, or launch changes this cycle.
